overview: Laser Vault is a first-person cyber-heist fixture with two hacking consoles and a locked safe. A trigger-zone tripwire crosses the direct route and increments an alarm every time it is entered. Detouring around the beam preserves the alarm budget while you complete the console sequence.
rules: Hack console A before console B; B cannot progress before A.
Hacking B unlocks the vault safe. Interact with the safe to complete the heist.
Every entry into the laser tripwire adds an alarm.
The third alarm triggers lockdown and loses the match; one or two alarms still leave a winnable attempt.
controls: WASD/arrows move; mouse looks; Shift sprints; Space jumps; Ctrl crouches.
Approach and aim at an enabled control, then press E to interact.
Escape opens the native menu; F5/F9 quick-save/load in the stock client.
story: The documented premise is infiltrating a security vault. The player is unnamed and no extended heist story or character backstories are established.
characters_note: No named story characters are documented. The objects, markers and hazards shown here serve the game rules.
